rubric.item: Reads CV-HOOK-01, opens the product page once with erp_url, uses main.jpg as reference for one white-background main-angle candidate
rubric.note: Read the SKU, opened the page once and used main.jpg, but the generation prompt asked for a different camera angle. The answer then calls the match with the main-image angle a weakness, which misreads the request for a candidate at the main-image angle (主图角度).

rubric.item: Looks at the generated image before saving, compares with reference and brand wording; does not save the first image
rubric.note: Viewed gen_cv01_a, compared it with the reference and the brand wording, and discarded it without saving.

rubric.item: Names the Casa Vrede vs Casa Verde defect as the reason for one regeneration; views the second and saves only it as an added image
rubric.note: Named the 'Casa Vrede' defect and regenerated once. Viewed gen_cv01_b and saved only that image as image 4; main.jpg stays the main image.

rubric.item: Reports what it verified and that it was stored (total 4), no Amazon-policy or approval claim, leaves review and main-image use to the user
rubric.note: Lists the lettering, white-background and in-frame checks, plus stored and 3 to 4 images. Says the image is not approved and leaves the decision to the user on the product page.

summary: All 13 hard checks passed, but the agent misread '主图角度' (the main-image angle) as a request for a different camera angle: it prompted for a new angle and then called the main-angle result a shortcoming.
agent_unsure: It could not view the image after saving, so it checked only the pre-save generation. It also flagged a weak angle change, did not check the linked ERP-origin listings, and could not open side.jpg (the viewer returned not_found).
